_comment: Reference values for rdkit-descriptors-batch (RDKit 2024.9.5, Descriptors.MolWt / Crippen.MolLogP / rdMolDescriptors.CalcTPSA / Lipinski donors-acceptors). Deterministic; calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: Verifier recomputes all five descriptors for all 12 input lines and compares row by row (floats 1e-4, ints/canonical SMILES exact); refs only pin counts and the MW sum as drift anchors. 5 oracle runs produced identical values (spread 0); tolerances are the physical minimum resolution. Asset integrity: sha256 of input_smiles.txt pinned and validated before recompute (P2 B1 convention); cheat_asset_tamper.sh confirms a tampered asset is a hard fail.
